video-meetings.label: Video meetings
video-meetings.description: Connect your own Zoom or Microsoft Teams account to add video links to your meetings.
video-meetings.keywords: zoom, teams, microsoft teams, video, video call, meeting link, join link, conferencing, google meet

form.label: Video conferencing
form.needsStart: Set a start time to add a video link or a calendar entry.
form.meetNote: A Google Meet link is part of a calendar event, so this meeting is also added to your calendar.
form.teamsViaCalendar: This Teams link is made by your Microsoft 365 calendar, so this meeting is also added to it.
form.invite: Send a calendar invitation to the contact
form.inviteHint: Your calendar emails the invitation to the contact's email address. Our own email invitation is not affected.

row.invited: The calendar sent the contact an invitation
row.retried: The video link and calendar entry were checked again.
row.retryFailed: That did not work. The meeting is saved; you can try again.

problem.not_installed: The {provider} integration is not installed for this workspace.
problem.not_connected: Your {provider} account is not connected. Connect it in Settings, Video meetings.
problem.needs_reconnect: Your {provider} connection needs to be renewed. Reconnect it in Settings, Video meetings.
problem.not_configured: {provider} has not been set up for this platform yet. Ask your platform administrator.
problem.calendar_not_connected: The calendar is not connected, so the meeting could not be added to it.
problem.provider_failed: {provider} did not answer. The meeting is saved; try again.
problem.no_start_time: A video link needs a start time on the meeting.

calendarProblem.calendar_not_connected: The meeting could not be added to the calendar because no calendar is connected.
calendarProblem.provider_failed: The calendar did not answer, so the meeting is not on it yet. The meeting is saved; try again.
calendarProblem.other: The meeting could not be added to the calendar.

page.title: Video meetings
page.subtitle: Connect your own Zoom or Microsoft Teams account. The Add meeting form then offers a video link, made in your account and shown on the meeting with a Join button.

forbidden.title: You cannot use this page
forbidden.body: Ask a workspace admin to give your role access to edit contacts.

failure.generic: Your video connections could not be loaded.

zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.about: Creates a Zoom meeting in your Zoom account for each meeting you schedule, moves it when you move the meeting and removes it when you delete the meeting.

teams.name: Microsoft Teams
teams.about: Creates a Teams meeting in your Microsoft work or school account for each meeting you schedule, and updates or removes it with the meeting.

lastError.forbidden: The provider refused the last request. Your account may not be allowed to create meetings.
lastError.rate_limited: The provider is limiting requests right now.
lastError.unavailable: The provider did not answer the last request.

notInstalled.canInstall: Your workspace has not installed {provider} yet. Install it from the Marketplace, then connect your account here.
notInstalled.cannotInstall: Your workspace has not installed {provider} yet. Ask a workspace admin to install it from the Marketplace.

page.unavailable: {provider} is installed, but your platform operator has switched its set-up off, so it cannot be connected right now. Ask your platform operator.

outcome.denied: {provider} was not connected because the sign-in was cancelled.
outcome.failed: {provider} could not be connected. Try again.
outcome.expired: That sign-in took too long. Press Connect again.
outcome.not_configured: {provider} has not been set up for this platform yet.
outcome.notYours: That sign-in was started by someone else, so nothing was connected.

page.disconnectBody: Meetings that already have a {provider} link keep it, but moving or deleting those meetings can no longer change the room. You can connect again at any time.
page.calendarNote: Google Meet and Teams links made through your calendar need no connection here: they use the calendar your workspace has already connected.
page.notAvailable: Your platform operator has not made {provider} available yet: it still has to be set up and published in the Marketplace. There is nothing to install yet, so ask your platform operator to switch it on.
page.installedHint: {provider} is installed for your workspace. Connect your own account to add {provider} links to your meetings.

operator.title: Video meetings setup
operator.missing: {count, plural, one {1 step missing} other {# steps missing}}
operator.loadFailed: The setup checklist could not be loaded.
operator.fake: Development mode: the fake Zoom and Teams adapters are bound, so people can connect without a real account. The checklist below shows what a real platform still needs.

intro.zoom: Workspaces cannot see or use Zoom until the Zoom app credentials are set and this listing is published.
intro.teams: Workspaces cannot see or use Microsoft Teams until a Microsoft app is available and this listing is published.

operator.teamsFallback: Teams uses its own values above when both are set, otherwise the Microsoft Calendar app saved in the console.

source.environment: The values come from the environment.
source.console: The values come from the console, Microsoft Calendar page.

operator.switchedOff: The Microsoft Calendar integration is switched off in the console, which switches Teams off with it.

redirect.label: Redirect address to register at the provider

hint.zoom: Add this exact address as the redirect URL of the Zoom app.
hint.teams: Add this exact address as a redirect URI of the Microsoft app, next to the calendar one, and add the delegated permission OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite.

listing.label: Marketplace listing published
listing.missing: The listing does not exist in the catalogue.
listing.notPublished: The listing is not published (status: {status}). Approve and publish a version below, then workspaces can install it.
listing.published: Published: workspaces can find and install it.
